hedging_delta.evidence: More conditional language on funding milestones, e.g. 'should we determine to build a fab' and 'we would need to see' vs prior's firmer PMT progress claims.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior Q1 FY25 revenue guide was $185M-$215M; current Q2 FY25 guide is $160M-$200M, a lower range.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: Design-wins backlog was $9B design-ins/$21B EV design-ins cumulative prior call vs $11B backlog now cited differently; EV revenue growth decelerated from ~300% guided to 2.5x (150%) actual.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New restructuring plan: closing Farmers Branch epi facility, suspending Saarland fab, 20% workforce cuts, $200M CHIPS PMT/debt package details not present before.

tone_delta.evidence: Shift from 'ahead of plan' progress framing to 'critical inflection point' and repeated emphasis on right-sizing/restructuring rather than growth superlatives.

demand_language_delta.evidence: Prior: EV revenue +300% y/y expected next quarter; current: EV revenue grew only 2.5x y/y and I&E 'continued softness' with weak orders, indicating deceleration.
